Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:46329
Court No. - 91
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 3721 of 2020

Applicant :- Lala Ram
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Anr
Counsel for Applicant :- Kartikeya Shukla,Priyanka Devi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

2. Present application under Section 482 of Cr PC has been filed by the applicants, praying for quashing the summoning order dated 24.06.2019 along with entire Complaint Case No.3873 of 2018 (Pramod Kumar Singh Vs. Lala Ram) under Section 406 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Orai,
District Jalaun pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jalaun at Orai.

entities.text:

District Jalaun
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jalaun at Orai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted that applicant and the opposite party no.2 are brother-in-law (Samadhi) to each other.
The son of opposite party no.2 is married to the daughter of applicant.

The date of the incident is noted in the compliant as 12.06.2016 while the complaint has been filed on 03.10.2018.
4.

It is further submitted that the daughter of the applicant, namely, Anita Devi has lodged an FIR under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 376, 511 and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, in which charge sheet has been filed and the trial is going on.
The present proceeding has been initiated against the applicant.

1 5.

entities.text: Lala Ram vs State Of U.P. And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned AGA opposed the prayer and submitted that the applicant and the opposite party no.2 are known to each other.
Since, they are close relatives.
Specific allegations are made against the applicant.
The applicant had taken Rs.2,50,000/- and Jewellery of Rs.50,000/- from the opposite party no.2 for treatment of his wife but he did not return the jewellery as well as money.
On the basis of the primary evidence recorded under Sections 200 and 202 Cr.P.C., the summoning order has been passed.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and after going through the material available on record, the prayer made by the applicants, is refused.

7. However, it is provided that in case the applicants apply for bail within a period of 30 days from today, their applications for bail shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously in view of law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.
8.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For a period of 30 days from today or till the applicants surrender and apply for bail, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
